text:
Situation: Amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-10-28 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 48 months. Corvale East holds 294 units of the 200 mg/5 mL + 28.5 mg/5 mL 100 mL presentation with 19.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 425 units of the same presentation with 27.3 days on hand and 397 units of the 400 mg/5 mL 50 mL presentation with 26 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows the drug listed continuously from 2022-10-28 through 2026-10-21. An FDA inspection of NuCare Pharmaceuticals Inc. (FEI 3003294404) ended 2020-01-10 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-02-26 — 1022 days before the shortage posting. NuCare's most recent inspection was NAI on 2025-03-12. Asclemed USA Inc. DBA Enovachem (FEI 3001452204) received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-09-27 and a Warning Letter on 2019-06-11.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage. Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., Sandoz Inc., and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. are not on FDA's shortage list today and represent viable supply alternatives.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (plants 2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N in Jordan) — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Sandoz Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Chartwell RX, LLC and Devatis Inc. as secondary options — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further shortage list changes; relying solely on current inventory beyond 19 days.
